name: refunds
description: Refunds: a check agent proposes each one; under the limit it pays on its own, over the limit a person decides. Paying is an effect: never cut by a newer request, its forward held back when stale, a crash recorded as unknown. A reconcile source asks the ledger what really happened.

neurons.description: Refund requests, keyed by refund id (a resubmitted request replaces its first).
The refund agent: checks the booking and proposes the refund.
Under the limit: on to pay. Over: quiet.
Over the limit: the approver's ask. Under: quiet.
Sam approves or denies a large refund.
Pays the refund, idempotent by id. An effect.
Sends the customer's receipt for a forwarded payment.
Where an unknown is asked about, by refund id.
Reads the ledger: was it paid?
